# AirTrackBot

> AI-powered flight price tracking and prediction service delivering real-time fare alerts through Telegram for travelers worldwide.

AirTrackBot monitors airfares across major airlines including Lufthansa, American Airlines, Delta, and dozens of international carriers, helping travelers find the best time to book flights. The service combines price prediction algorithms with instant Telegram notifications to help budget-conscious travelers save money on domestic and international routes.

## Key Topics

- Telegram bot
- Flight price tracking
- Price alerts

## Core Tools & Features

- [Flight Price Predictor – Find the Best Time to Book](https://airtrackbot.com/flight-price-predictor): AI-powered flight price predictor shows when fares will rise or drop
- [Low Fare Calendar for Air France Flights – Cheapest Dates](https://airtrackbot.com/air-france-low-fare-calendar): Find cheapest Air France flight dates with low fare calendar tool
- [Low Fare Calendar for JetBlue Flights – Cheapest Dates](https://airtrackbot.com/jetblue-low-fare-calendar): Compare JetBlue fares by month to find cheapest flight dates

## Major Airline Price Trackers

- [American Airlines Flight Price Tracker](https://airtrackbot.com/american-airlines-flight-price-tracker): Track American Airlines fares with price alerts for domestic/intl routes
- [Asiana Airlines Flight Price Tracker](https://airtrackbot.com/asiana-airlines-flight-price-tracker): Track Asiana Airlines fares with price alerts via Telegram bot
- [Hong Kong Airlines Flight Price Tracker](https://airtrackbot.com/hong-kong-airlines-flight-price-tracker): Monitor Hong Kong Airlines prices and get alerts when fares drop
- [Air New Zealand Flight Price Tracker](https://airtrackbot.com/air-new-zealand-flight-price-tracker): Track Air New Zealand fares with AirTrack's Telegram price alerts
- [Jet2 Flight Price Tracker](https://airtrackbot.com/jet2-flight-price-tracker): Track Jet2 low-cost holiday flight prices with instant alerts
